names.note: Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 10 марта ст. ст., «Павел Таганрогский, прп.», with the rank abbreviation left off.

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 10 марта ст. ст. closes with: «Прп. Павла Таганрогского (1879).»

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 марта ст. ст. — «Прп. Павла Таганрогского (1879).»

attestations.note: Neither the day page nor name page 14807 carries a life. The name page lists a second day, «7 июня (прославление)», the day of his glorification; it is recorded here and the folder does not render on it. The name page also links an article on the portal, which is magazine writing and not the calendar, and was not read. The day page prints no hymn at all. **Added 8 October 2026:** the 7 июня day page has now been read and it carries him as its second entry, «Прав. Павла Таганрогского (прославление 1999).» — and what it prints is a GLORIFICATION and not a commemoration: «прославление 1999», the year he was numbered among the saints. The name page says the same of itself, listing «10 марта , 7 июня (прославление)». So the second day was already recorded here from the name page and is now confirmed from the day page itself; the row is NOT moved and this folder does not render on 7 июня. The 7 июня page prints one hymn, a troparion of the hieromartyr Феодот, and nothing under his name.
